about: Day-3 evidence file for the Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (Malta, HLTV event 8932, 14-18 Oct 2026). Compiled by session arena/b6f5405d on 2026-10-16 between 04:19Z and 04:40Z. Only RAW inputs are stored here (bookmaker decimal odds, Polymarket prices, official Valve points, Hotspawn crowd shares, HLTV facts). Every probability shown on the site is recomputed at build time by hotspawn/build.py from those inputs (margin removal / own-line curve), never typed in by hand. Hotspawn's crowd share is ownership only and is never an input to a probability.

display_timezone_note.detail: Kickoff is 14:00Z (Aurora-9z) and 17:00Z (BetBoom-Legacy) = 16:00 and 19:00 in Malta. Three independent machine-readable sources agree: Hotspawn's own TransferState epoch (start 2026-10-16T14:00:00Z, lock 13:54:00Z, lock_offset_sec 360) as read by this project's live capture; Polymarket's API record for both markets (start_utc 2026-10-16T14:00:00Z and 2026-10-16T17:00:00Z); and HLTV's page countdown (9h43m and 12h43m at ~04:26Z). Human-readable clocks differ by viewer timezone and must not be used: HLTV rendered 10:00 and 13:00 in this session's reads (viewer timezone, UTC-4 in the fetch path), Hotspawn rendered 14:00, and EGamersWorld rendered 16:00 and 19:00 (UTC+2, venue time).

facts: Aurora's last roster change is NOT days old. HLTV reported on 8 Jul 2026 that kyxsan joined from Falcons as in-game leader, completing the rebuild alongside Jimpphat (3 Jul 2026) and coach ash; MAJ3R, soulfly and coach Fabre left.

how_to_read: Pick column: the board's own decision, produced by hotspawn/model.py from its probability ladder (Pinnacle -> Polymarket -> own line). This section does not replace it; it shows the extra evidence behind the two S-tier fixtures.

Market line: arithmetic mean of the margin-removed probabilities of every outside price stored above. Bookmaker rows keep their overround removed proportionally; the Polymarket row is a price, normalised.
Our line: Valve's official points on the calibrated curve (k from data/calibration.json, fitted on Valve's own published results).
Crowd: Hotspawn pick share (ownership). It is displayed for leverage only and is never an input to any probability.

Swing play: where the crowd is heavily on one side but the outside estimates do not support that confidence, the upside for a chasing player is quantified in the table. It is labelled as a swing, not as the value pick.
limitations: Two snapshots are cited in this file: the hand reads of 2026-10-16 04:19Z-04:45Z and the live automation refresh of 2026-10-16 04:31:50Z (workflow run 38851072935) that closed the coverage gap and added a Pinnacle line for Aurora-9z. Where they differ (Polymarket 0.685 -> 0.695 and 0.605 -> 0.655; crowd picks 9 -> 16), the newer read is the one the board uses.

Hand reads are a snapshot inside the 04:19Z-04:40Z window. The automated board re-reads Pinnacle, Polymarket and Hotspawn every three hours and is the live authority; this file is the audited evidence behind the day-3 rows.

EGamersWorld relays bookmaker prices (bc.game); those rows are labelled as a secondary relay and their overround is removed before use. No price is ever taken from Hotspawn's own pick'em shares, from HLTV's visitor vote, or from HLTV's analytics page, which renders no readable odds.
Hotspawn publishes crowd ownership only, rounds each side, and drops the share at lock, so the share at lock time is unknowable from the outside.
Nothing here is a guarantee of a result: 9z beating Aurora on day 1 was an outcome the outside market priced at roughly 27-34%.
